name: badge-21
description: A subscriptions table whose status column uses badge variants.

files.content:
import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const rows = [ { customer: "Studio client", plan: "Designali Pro", status: "Active" }, { customer: "Freelance designer", plan: "Starter", status: "Trialing" }, { customer: "Agency team", plan: "Designali Pro", status: "Past due" }, { customer: "Startup founder", plan: "Team", status: "Canceled" }, ] const variants = { Active: "default", Trialing: "secondary", "Past due": "destructive", Canceled: "outline", } as const export default function SubscriptionTableStatus() { return (
Customer Plan Status {rows.map((row) => ( {row.customer} {row.plan} {row.status} ))}
) }
